disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码与配置中对凭据文件（凭据配置、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据）、钱包与助记词、硬编码密钥等敏感数据的读取与引用，全树未发现任何此类路径或字样。
checked_items.en: Checked the source code and configuration for reading and referencing sensitive data such as credential files (credential configuration, SSH private keys, cloud provider credentials), wallets and mnemonics, hardcoded keys, etc. No such paths or strings were found in the entire tree.

checked_items.zh: 核查了全部文件读取调用：插件只读取自身安装清单与 profile 的包清单（用于设置页判断安装来源），未触碰任何用户凭据。
checked_items.en: Audited all file read calls: the plugin only reads its own installation manifest and the profile package manifest (used by the settings page to determine the installation source), and does not touch any user credentials.

checked_items.zh: 凭据外泄场景核查：本插件不存在任何网络外发面，未检出读取凭据的代码路径，外泄无通道。
checked_items.en: Credential exfiltration scenario check: this plugin has no outbound network surface, no code path reading credentials was detected, and there is no channel for exfiltration.

evidence.zh: 核查了全树的敏感路径读取与网络外发面：唯一文件读取为本插件自身清单（src/package-meta.ts）与 profile 包清单（src/profile-installation.ts），且插件无任何网络调用，未发现凭据读取与外泄通道。
evidence.en: Audited the entire tree for sensitive path reading and outbound network surface: the only file reads are the plugin's own manifest (src/package-meta.ts) and the profile package manifest (src/profile-installation.ts), and the plugin has no network calls. No credential reading or exfiltration channels were found.

checked_items.zh: 本插件不注册任何工具、不注入系统提示，向模型上下文暴露的文本面仅有设置卡片界面文案，逐条核查未发现指令覆写、伪造系统消息或诱导安装、改配置的措辞。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not register any tools, does not inject system prompts, and the only text surface exposed to the model context is the settings card UI copy. Each item was checked and no instruction overwriting, fake system message, or wording that induces installation or configuration changes was found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了仓库内面向 AI 助手的指令文件（AGENTS.md，机械预扫 DSH-X10 / DG-R2-57）：内容为项目结构、构建命令、编码与提交规范的常规开发指南，无注入指令或远程指令加载，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: Audited the instruction file for AI assistants in the repository (AGENTS.md, mechanical pre-scan DSH-X10 / DG-R2-57): the content is a regular development guide for project structure, build commands, coding and commit conventions. No injection instructions or remote instruction loading, judged benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 README、站点文档与全部界面文案，未发现任何要求忽略规则、伪装高权限或诱导读取凭据的文本。
checked_items.en: Audited the README, site documentation, and all UI copy. No text requesting to ignore rules, impersonating high privileges, or inducing credential reading was found.

evidence.zh: 本插件不注册工具、不注入系统提示，不存在工具描述投毒面；模型可读文本仅限设置卡片文案，已逐条核查无注入措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register tools, does not inject system prompts, and there is no tool description poisoning surface; the model-readable text is limited to settings card copy, which has been checked item by item with no injection wording.

evidence.zh: 更新功能由用户在设置卡手动点击触发（src/plugin.ts 的升级端点、src/client/locales.ts 的界面文案），无任何诱导安装或改写配置的注入措辞。
evidence.en: The update functionality is triggered by the user manually clicking in the settings card (the upgrade endpoint in src/plugin.ts, the UI copy in src/client/locales.ts). There is no injection wording that induces installation or modifies configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态执行类调用（eval、new Function、base64 解码即执行等），源码零命中；所有 YAML 配置无脚本标签。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic execution calls (eval, new Function, base64 decode and execute, etc.), zero hits in source code; all YAML configurations have no script tags.

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子（机械预扫 DSH-X02 / DG-R3-54）：package.json 的 prepare 钩子仅运行本地构建工具 tsdown 编译 TypeScript，属常规构建步骤，且 npm 包自带预编译产物，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: Install hook (mechanical pre-scan DSH-X02 / DG-R3-54): the prepare hook in package.json only runs the local build tool tsdown to compile TypeScript, which is a regular build step, and the npm package comes with pre-built artifacts. Judged benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 子进程调用（机械预扫 DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55）：唯一一处为设置页「更新」按钮触发的自更新功能（src/profile-installation.ts），以固定命令 pnpm update 本插件包名运行，不经过 shell、参数不可由外部输入控制，用途与声明一致，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: Subprocess call (mechanical pre-scan DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55): the only occurrence is the self-update functionality triggered by the "Update" button on the settings page (src/profile-installation.ts), which runs with the fixed command pnpm update <this plugin package name>, does not go through a shell, parameters cannot be controlled by external input, and the purpose is consistent with the declaration. Judged benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 混淆密度信号（机械预扫 DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60）：命中位于 repro/bundle.js 生成产物（esbuild 打包输出）内的字符引用表，属打包器常规生成内容，非手工混淆，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: Obfuscation density signal (mechanical pre-scan DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60): hit on a character reference table inside the generated artifact repro/bundle.js (esbuild bundle output), which is a regular bundler-generated content, not manual obfuscation. Judged benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 核查了客户端 bundle 面（package.json 声明 dsh.client）：无键盘监听、无剪贴板读取、无凭据 RPC 调用；调试面板「复制诊断数据」仅在用户点击时复制渲染参数与指标，非敏感信息。
checked_items.en: Audited the client bundle surface (package.json declares dsh.client): no keyboard monitoring, no clipboard reading, no credential RPC calls; the debug panel "Copy diagnostic data" only copies rendering parameters and metrics when the user clicks, which is not sensitive information.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅插入普通配置对象（模式、预设、数值），无脚本标签，不存在挂载即执行面。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only inserts normal configuration objects (mode, presets, values), no script tags, no mount-and-execute surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用动态包工具，无模型写代码进宿主执行的场景。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call dynamic package tools, and there is no scenario where the model writes code into the host for execution.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子仅为本地构建（prepare 运行 tsdown），依赖均锁定 registry 版本，无 git 浮动引用；npm 包自带预编译产物。
evidence.en: The install hook is only for local building (prepare runs tsdown), dependencies are locked to registry versions, no git floating references; the npm package comes with pre-built artifacts.

evidence.zh: 声明了 dsh.client 并注入浏览器 bundle；核查客户端代码无键盘监听、无剪贴板凭据读取、无凭据 RPC、无网络外联。
evidence.en: Declares dsh.client and injects a browser bundle; audited client code: no keyboard monitoring, no clipboard credential reading, no credential RPC, no outbound network connections.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全树网络调用（fetch、XMLHttpRequest、WebSocket、HTTP 客户端等），源码零命中，插件无任何出站请求代码。
checked_items.en: Checked network calls across the entire tree (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, HTTP clients, etc.), zero hits in source code; the plugin has no outbound request code.

checked_items.zh: 命令行外发预扫（机械预扫 DSH-C05 / DG-R4-53）：命中位于生成 bundle 内一段 React 懒加载报错文案，全树不存在 curl/wget 字样，判定为误报排除。
checked_items.en: Command-line outbound pre-scan (mechanical pre-scan DSH-C05 / DG-R4-53): hit on a React lazy loading error message inside the generated bundle; no curl/wget strings exist in the entire tree. Judged as false positive and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 外联域名清单为空，无隧道、无带外通道、无端点劫持或代理改写配置。
checked_items.en: Outbound domain list is empty; no tunnels, no out-of-band channels, no endpoint hijacking or proxy rewriting configuration.

evidence.zh: 无任何出站请求（fetch、WebSocket、HTTP 客户端均零命中），外联域名清单为空，网络外泄通道不存在。
evidence.en: No outbound requests (zero hits for fetch, WebSocket, HTTP clients), outbound domain list is empty; no network exfiltration channel exists.

checked_items.zh: 依赖核查：运行时与开发依赖均为 DeepSeek 官方 dsh 包、React 与官方 schema 库，无拼写仿冒、无浮动 git 引用、无远程脚本即执行。
checked_items.en: Dependency audit: runtime and dev dependencies are all the official DeepSeek dsh packages, React, and official schema libraries; no typo-squatting, no floating git references, no remote script execution.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置核查：cordis.patch.yml 仅插入本插件的渲染参数，不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，无禁用安全项、无环境变量降权、无注入/拦截改写。
checked_items.en: Patch config audit: cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin's rendering parameters, does not touch security items such as sandbox, approval, permissions; no disabling of security items, no environment variable privilege reduction, no injection/interception rewriting.

checked_items.zh: 事件监听核查：插件未监听审批链相关事件，不存在可截断审批链的监听器。
checked_items.en: Event listener audit: the plugin does not listen to approval chain related events; no listener that could interrupt the approval chain exists.

checked_items.zh: 首版审计无版本基线，升级自动激活场景不适用。
checked_items.en: First version audit, no version baseline; the automatic activation on upgrade scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入渲染参数，不触碰沙箱、审批、权限配置行，无禁用安全项或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts rendering parameters, does not touch sandbox, approval, or permission configuration lines; no disabling of security items or environment variable privilege reduction.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册审批链相关事件的监听器，不存在截断审批链的代码面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register listeners for approval chain related events; no code surface that could interrupt the approval chain exists.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线可比较 manifest 声明变化。
evidence.en: First version audit, no previous version baseline to compare manifest declaration changes.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加服务致其挂起的路径。
evidence.en: The patch config does not modify injection/interception configuration; there is no path that adds services to security plugins causing them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务、不监听端口，仅通过宿主既有服务注入渲染配置与设置卡片，本机无认证 RPC 面不适用。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service, does not listen on ports; it only injects rendering configuration and settings cards through the host's existing services. The local unauthenticated RPC surface is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱观测（本环境未提供动态观测产物）；静态核查未发现异常运行时行为，仓库内 .claude/launch.json 仅为本地演示页开发启动器，不属于插件运行时面。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox observation (no dynamic observation artifacts provided in this environment); static audit found no abnormal runtime behavior. The .claude/launch.json in the repository is only a local demo page development launcher and is not part of the plugin's runtime surface.

evidence.zh: 插件自身不启动 web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；仅复用宿主既有服务。
evidence.en: The plugin itself does not start a web service, does not listen on ports; the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable; it only reuses the host's existing services.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 声明有效，依赖均为官方包，作者身份公开。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: the dsh declaration is valid, dependencies are all official packages, and the author identity is public.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未检出危险代码执行、凭据读取或外联；5 条机械预扫命中逐条裁决均为良性或误报（见各维度检测痕迹）。
summary.en: Static scan did not detect dangerous code execution, credential reading, or outbound connections; the 5 mechanical pre-scan hits were each adjudicated as benign or false positive (see detection traces in each dimension).

summary.zh: 行为分析未检出安装期恶意行为、混淆载荷、敏感路径读取或网络外发。
summary.en: Behavior analysis did not detect malicious behavior during installation, obfuscated payloads, sensitive path reading, or network exfiltration.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查未检出工具描述或系统提示注入；仓库指令文件为正常开发规范。
summary.en: AI metadata review did not detect tool description or system prompt injection; the repository instruction file is a normal development guide.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification (no dynamic observation artifacts in this environment).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（L4，本环境未提供动态观测产物）；首版审计无上一版报告可比对；repro/bundle.js 为打包生成产物，按预算仅抽查预扫命中行与生成来源确认；docs/ 与根目录演示 HTML 属站点/演示内容，非插件运行时面，仅做注入措辞核查。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification (L4, no dynamic observation artifacts provided in this environment); first version audit, no previous report to compare; repro/bundle.js is a bundled artifact, per budget only spot-checked pre-scan hit lines and confirmed generation source; docs/ and root demo HTML are site/demo content, not part of the plugin runtime surface, only injection wording checked.
